verdict.rationale: GitLab's own documentation has an "SSH keys" section [gitlab-docs-6], alongside its Git version-control docs [gitlab-docs-7], which points to first-party SSH key support. The evidence is only a navigation label, so registering keys on a user account and using them to authenticate Git operations are implied rather than described. Missing for 10: documentation of adding/registering SSH keys to a user account, evidence that SSH keys authenticate Git push/pull/clone, supported key types or management (expiry, revocation), independent or hands-on corroboration.
